newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end down on selling over uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end down on selling over uncertainty.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed lower amid selling by investors wary about the looming political uncertaity over opposition plan for anti-government protest, brokers said.
The benchmark Dhaka Stock Exchange index fell 17.75 points or 1.0 percent at 1,702.49 on a turnover of 70.3 million taka. Of 119 issues traded 86 lost, 29 gained and four unchanged.
"The market sentiment was bearish after former prime minister and opposition leader Begum Khaleda Zia threatened at a meeting to launch anti-government movement," said one broker.
Bangladesh Tobacco lost 7.08 taka to 218.45, Beximco Pharma fell 1.62 to 230.58 and Reckitt & Colman rose 9.85 to 295.94.
